usage: dictionary_md_audit.py [-h] [--root ROOT] [--output OUTPUT]
                              [--config CONFIG] [--subject SUBJECTS]
                              [--api-url API_URL] [--model MODEL]
                              [--workers WORKERS]
                              [--parallel-subjects PARALLEL_SUBJECTS]
                              [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--retries RETRIES]
                              [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]
                              [--sample-count SAMPLE_COUNT]
                              [--chunk-chars CHUNK_CHARS]
                              [--strict-text-quality]
                              [--max-generic-headword-ratio MAX_GENERIC_HEADWORD_RATIO]
                              [--min-candidate-headwords MIN_CANDIDATE_HEADWORDS]
                              [--knowledge-value-mode]
                              [--max-nonknowledge-headword-ratio MAX_NONKNOWLEDGE_HEADWORD_RATIO]
                              [--drop-nonknowledge-headword-ratio DROP_NONKNOWLEDGE_HEADWORD_RATIO]
                              [--min-headword-evidence MIN_HEADWORD_EVIDENCE]
                              [--limit LIMIT] [--pending-limit PENDING_LIMIT]
                              [--skip-priority-workbook]
                              [--symlink-classified] [--pass-challenge]
                              [--challenge-sample-count CHALLENGE_SAMPLE_COUNT]
                              {prepare,run,challenge,materialize,all}

跨学科知识型书籍 Markdown 三级 LLM 审核

positional arguments:
  {prepare,run,challenge,materialize,all}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT
  --output OUTPUT
  --config CONFIG       学科与书籍目录 JSON 配置；省略时使用内置十学科配置
  --subject SUBJECTS    可重复；默认 all
  --api-url API_URL
  --model MODEL
  --workers WORKERS
  --parallel-subjects PARALLEL_SUBJECTS
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --retries RETRIES
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --sample-count SAMPLE_COUNT
  --chunk-chars CHUNK_CHARS
  --strict-text-quality
                        启用正文零明确错误、正文语言和候选词头质量硬门槛
  --max-generic-headword-ratio MAX_GENERIC_HEADWORD_RATIO
                        严格模式允许的泛化或非知识点候选词头最大比例
  --min-candidate-headwords MIN_CANDIDATE_HEADWORDS
                        严格模式允许 PASS 所需的最少候选词头证据量
  --knowledge-value-mode
                        启用主体知识可用性判断、带上下文抽样和原文证据核对，不使用词头比例门槛
  --max-nonknowledge-headword-ratio MAX_NONKNOWLEDGE_HEADWORD_RATIO
                        旧参数，仅兼容命令行；定性模式不使用比例门槛
  --drop-nonknowledge-headword-ratio DROP_NONKNOWLEDGE_HEADWORD_RATIO
                        旧参数，仅兼容命令行；定性模式不使用比例门槛
  --min-headword-evidence MIN_HEADWORD_EVIDENCE
                        旧参数，仅兼容命令行；定性模式不使用词头个数门槛
  --limit LIMIT
  --pending-limit PENDING_LIMIT
                        每次只处理指定数量的未完成书目，便于按 API 限额分批续跑
  --skip-priority-workbook
                        仅生成 CSV 与三级分类，不生成重点问题 MD 段落工作簿
  --symlink-classified  三级目录使用指向原 MD 的符号链接，避免重复复制大文件
  --pass-challenge      对可疑 PASS 启用独立反证复核；all 会运行该阶段，materialize 会覆盖其结果
  --challenge-sample-count CHALLENGE_SAMPLE_COUNT
                        PASS 反证复核的最大样本数，默认 8
